inclusion_rule: Studies that reconstruct a continuous acoustic speech representation (spectrogram, mel features, envelope or waveform) from neural recordings (EEG, MEG, ECoG, sEEG or intracortical) during perceived, produced, mimed or imagined speech and evaluate the reconstruction. Boundary: classification-only and text-only decoders are excluded; auditory attention decoding that only tracks an envelope to select a talker is counted by the ledger pattern but is not a reconstruction study; versions of one study count once. Design categories are full-text pattern matches and overlap: correlation, identification among candidates, mel-cepstral distortion, human listening test, STOI.
